name: Ms. Librarian
message: "How nostalgic... This place has been here since I was still alive."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's changed quite a bit, though. That area over there still has traces of the past, but this part is nothing like it was."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It wasn't kept this neatly back then, and the flower displays were much more modest too."

name: Shiori
message: "It's nice walking around with someone who knows what this place used to be like."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'd love to take my time and reminisce about those days, but..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I take it that's her? The ghost who does not respond?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'll speak to her. It wouldn't hurt to try."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Hello."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Quite a lovely day today, isn't it? It must feel wonderful to be surrounded by flowers and bathed in sunlight."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "People tend to picture ghosts as creatures of the night, but I actually prefer the daytime. Do you feel the same?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Hmm, I see."

name: Shiori
message: "She still won't respond... just like back then."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Indeed... she's in the final stages. She's lost her ego, and her very existence is starting to fade."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I've met a ghost with similar symptoms before."

name: Shiori
message: "Did you know each other?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It was one-sided on my part. She couldn't even recognize me."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "She was an elderly woman. She would sit there all alone, crouched down, staring blankly at the ground."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I couldn't bring myself to leave her alone, so I made it a daily habit to sit beside her as I read books..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Until one day, she suddenly vanished like smoke right before my eyes."

name: Shiori
message: "All sorts of people really do gather at the library, don't they? I never realized."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I've been around a long time, so I've experienced quite a lot."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "At this rate, she'll end up the same way. It wouldn't be surprising if she vanished any second now."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I don't know if she can still recover from that state, but..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "This encounter, too, must have some meaning to it."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And you may already be holding the key to her recovery."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "In any case, let us try everything we can."

name: Shiori
message: "Everything we can... then how about we try calling out to her?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That sounds good. Now, let us have our buddy call out a name. Anyone will do."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It might be her name, or it might be someone who can awaken her sense of self."
"Kugayama, Shiori."
"Kirishiki, Nagisa."
"Aoi, Lumina."
"Uribayashi, Rina."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "No reaction."

name: Shiori
message: "That startled me. You suddenly called out my name."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "With your memories still missing, I can't say for sure that you two weren't acquainted."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "But even if you were, your relationship wasn't strong enough to make her remember who she was."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Now, onto the next. Let us try every name we know."

name: Shiori
message: "Looks like she doesn't have a deep tie with Gyaruko-san either."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I was hoping she'd be connected somehow, but I suppose it won't be that simple."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Now, onto the next attempt."

name: Shiori
message: "Looks like a bust..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I was hoping for an unexpected connection, but I suppose things won't be that easy."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Let us try a different name."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Oh?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "We've got a reaction. However..."

name: Shiori
message: "Is... she okay...?"

name: Fleeting Woman
message: "Lumina... Lu, mi, na......"

name: Fleeting Woman
message: "Lumina, Lumina, Lumina, Lumina..."

name: Fleeting Woman
message: "Luminaluminaluminaluminaluminaluminaluminaluminaluminaluminaluminaluminaluminaluminaluminalumina!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It would seem... we've set off her trigger."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's likely not her own name, but someone else's—someone she hates."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Still, it's progress. Now that her attention is on us, we should be able to probe for a response."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Try calling out a name again. She might remember her own this time."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "But do be careful. If we set off another trigger... she'll probably attack."
"Kugayama, Shiori."
"Kirishiki, Nagisa."
"Aoi, Lumina."
"Uribayashi, Rina."

name: Fleeting Woman
message: "Lumina... Lu, mi, na......"
"Kugayama, Shiori."
"Kirishiki, Nagisa."
"Aoi, Lumina."
"Uribayashi, Rina."

name: Fleeting Woman
message: "Luminaluminaluminalumina!"
"Kugayama, Shiori."
"Kirishiki, Nagisa."
"Aoi, Lumina."
"Uribayashi, Rina."

name: Fleeting Woman
message: "Lu, mi, na..."

name: Fleeting Woman
message: "LUMINAAA!!!"
(Try again)
(Return to Title Screen)
"Kugayama, Shiori."
"Kirishiki, Nagisa."
"Aoi, Lumina."
"Uribayashi, Rina."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Well done. You've hit the mark."

name: Shiori
message: "But what does this mean...? I mean..."

name: Shiori
message: "Isn't Kirishiki Nagisa... Gyaruko-san?"

name: Fleeting Woman
message: "My head... feels fuzzy... Like I'm gonna puke..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Would you be Kirishiki Nagisa, perhaps?"

name: Nagisa
message: ".......Yeah... Who're you?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "A ghost, just like you."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, I'm a ghost too."

name: Nagisa
message: "Oh... right... I died... I've been dead for a while......"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'm sorry, but just to be certain..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Your name is Kirishiki Nagisa. Is that correct?"

name: Nagisa
message: "...I told you, that's right."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...This is getting strange. There are a few possibilities to consider, however..."

name: Nagisa
message: "...What's going on? Why do you know my name?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...We will need to proceed carefully. May I handle this?"

name: Shiori
message: "Okay. We'll just watch from here."

name: Nagisa
message: "Could you stop talking as if I'm not around?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "My apologies. I heard about you from an acquaintance."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Aoi Lumina-san."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It doesn't seem like you two were friends."

name: Nagisa
message: "Of course not. She killed me!"

name: Shiori
message: "Huh?"

name: Nagisa
message: "What, did you think she was a nice girl? Or maybe you just didn't notice she's been pulling wool over your eyes."

name: Nagisa
message: "That broad pushed me off my apartment building. She *killed* me."

name: Nagisa
message: "So, you heard about me from Lumina, right? What did she say? And why the heck would she even talk about me?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...You were in a rather precarious state until now. She was worried."

name: Nagisa
message: "What? Me? You mean I'm in danger?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yes. You had lost your ego and were on the verge of disappearing."

name: Nagisa
message: "My ego...?"

name: Nagisa
message: "...So that's why my head feels all fuzzy... Ugh, this sucks."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Do you remember what you were doing here?"

name: Nagisa
message: "...I dunno. But now I'm convinced that I really was about to disappear."

name: Nagisa
message: "It felt like I'd been inside a dream the whole time. Like my existence itself was blurry..."

name: Nagisa
message: "Where... the flower garden?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yes."

name: Nagisa
message: "Maybe I was trying to fade away... in my favorite place... I dunno..."

name: Nagisa
message: "Wait, *her?* Worried about *me*?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yes."

name: Nagisa
message: "No way. That's impossible. I'm sure she just sent you here to check if I've disappeared already."

name: Nagisa
message: "That selfish bitch would never worry about other people, much less someone she herself killed."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Were you close in life?"

name: Nagisa
message: "...Childhood friends. I thought we were besties. Until she killed me, at least."

name: Nagisa
message: "And you? What's your relationship with her?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Hmm... you could say Lumina-san is my research subject."

name: Nagisa
message: "...What?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I study ghosts. By speaking with all kinds of ghosts, I deepen my understanding of them, and of myself as well."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I've heard a great deal from Lumina-san. Approaching you was part of my research."

name: Nagisa
message: "...Wait, don't tell me..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Hmm?"

name: Nagisa
message: "She's dead too?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Indeed she is."

name: Nagisa
message: "Pfft."

name: Nagisa
message: "Ahaha! Imagine killing someone, and then winding up dead yourself! What a loser! Pfft! Ahahahahaha!"

name: Nagisa
message: "Phew... Ehehe, thanks. This might be the best I've felt since I died."

name: Nagisa
message: "Although... It would've been better if I killed her myself. A lot more satisfying, definitely."

name: Nagisa
message: "Why did she have to go and die on her own like that? If she was going to die anyway, she should've at least let me kill her..."

name: Nagisa
message: "Damn it, damn it damn it... damn it...!"

name: Nagisa
message: "So, where's that broad now?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...I'd like to confirm something, just in case."

name: Nagisa
message: "What? Whaddya want?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If you had to describe Aoi Lumina-san in one word—would that be 'gyaru'?"

name: Nagisa
message: "...Maybe. I don't know what she thinks of herself, though."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Does she tie her hair into two bunches on either side? Like this?"

name: Nagisa
message: "When she was in her uniform, I think so..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Any other distinctive features?"

name: Nagisa
message: "Um... she always left her uniform unbuttoned at the top, like she was trying to lure guys in. She was practically showing off how lax her school's rules were. I hated walking around with her..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "So you went to different schools, then?"

name: Nagisa
message: "Of course we did. She's an idiot, and our grades were miles apart."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I see. Thank you."

name: Nagisa
message: "So, where is she now?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "We don't know."

name: Nagisa
message: "Hah?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "She's always wandering around town. I usually just run into her by chance, so I don't know where she is right now."

name: Nagisa
message: "I'd love to go look for her, but I don't have the energy yet."

name: Nagisa
message: "If you find her... could you bring her here? I'll make it worth your while."

name: Nagisa
message: "You can even make me your research subject."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "No, that won't be necessary. You've already let me closely observe someone recovering after losing themselves."

name: Nagisa
message: "...You're weird."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If you do reunite with Lumina-san, what do you plan to do?"

name: Nagisa
message: "I won't say. You'd probably try to stop me."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...I see."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Very well, we'll be off then."
"Goodbye."

name: Nagisa
message: "Make sure you bring her here, alright? Promise."

name: Shiori
message: "What was that about just now?"

name: Shiori
message: "Didn't Gyaruko-san say *she* was Kirishiki Nagisa?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "She did introduce herself as such."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Things are indeed getting strange..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's possible her memories were muddled from having just recovered her sense of self, leading her to believe she is Kirishiki Nagisa."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "However... her description of Aoi Lumina matched Gyaruko-san perfectly."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "In other words, that woman back there was the real Kirishiki Nagisa, and Gyaruko-san's real name isn't Kirishiki Nagisa, but Aoi Lumina."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That would be the most reasonable conclusion. However..."

name: Shiori
message: "Why would Gyaruko-san...?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Possibility one: Gyaruko-san's memories are muddled."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "In short, she didn't lie, but simply came to believe she was Kirishiki Nagisa."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If that's the case, hearing the name Aoi Lumina might cause her memories to fully return."
"We've already told her."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Pardon?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, we should've told her that name already."

name: Shiori
message: "But Gyaruko-san said she didn't know it."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "So before you even mentioned the name Kirishiki Nagisa, you had already talked to her about Aoi Lumina..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...If that's the case, then..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "We still cannot rule out possibility one. Hearing a name doesn't necessarily restore a ghost's memories."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's still possible that in Gyaruko-san's case, hearing her own name didn't restore her memories."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Instead, she needed to hear the name of her best friend, Kirishiki Nagisa... and mistakenly came to believe she herself was Kirishiki Nagisa."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It is well within the realm of possibility. However, if that wasn't the case..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If her memories had actually returned the moment she heard the name Aoi Lumina..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Then that leads us to possibility two: Gyaruko-san lied. She deliberately gave a false name."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "We don't know why. However... if what Kirishiki-san said was true, then Gyaruko-san would be a murderer."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "She may have lied to hide her crime. The logic would make sense."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Also..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'm simply imagining the worst-case scenario right now. I'd rather keep these deductions to myself until I've gathered enough evidence."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Besides, at this stage, Kirishiki Nagisa-san's testimony can't be trusted either. She was on the verge of losing her sense of self just moments ago."

name: Shiori
message: "So you mean it might've just been an accident, but she convinced herself it was Aoi Lumina-san's fault?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Exactly."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "In fact, it's entirely possible that the fading woman herself is Aoi Lumina, and that Gyaruko-san truly is Kirishiki Nagisa, just as she claimed."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Which is precisely why we need to proceed carefully... We first need to properly confirm both of their identities."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If Gyaruko-san is lying, then it's only reasonable to expect that she won't tell us the truth. Kirishiki-san's testimony is unreliable as well..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "We'll need someone else to verify who they are. But the question now... is how."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It would've been easiest if the fading woman could come with us, but she didn't seem able to move yet... If only we could take her photo... but that doesn't work with ghosts."
(Take a photo of Ms. Librarian)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...? Did you just take a photo of me?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'm sorry to say that ghosts don't appear in photographs..."
(Show her the photo)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's me!"

name: Shiori
message: "Our buddy always takes a picture of me every time I die, too."

name: Shiori
message: "I figured it was only natural that we'd show up in them."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "But how...? Could your phone have some special power hidden within...?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...No, come to think of it, I never actually tried it. The idea that ghosts don't appear was nothing more than my own biased assumption..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "So ghosts can appear in photos... Incredible, a whole new discovery!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Apologies. I got a little too excited there. Since we can take photos, confirming identities should be easy."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's go back to Kirishiki-san and ask to take her picture."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry, could we talk again for a moment?"

name: Nagisa
message: "Whoa, you spooked me there... What, did you find her already?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Not yet, but there's something we'd like your help with."

name: Nagisa
message: "...Yeah?"

name: Shiori
message: "We'd like to take your photo."

name: Nagisa
message: "What? Why?"

name: Shiori
message: "Well, um..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "For documentation. I keep photos of those I speak with as research material."

name: Nagisa
message: "Hmm... I guess that's fine. Do ghosts even show up in photos?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. Our buddy here can take them."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It'll be quicker to show you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Now then. Buddy, if you'd do the honors."
(Take a photo)

name: Nagisa
message: "...Okay, that came out of nowhere. At least give me a heads-up or something... So, did it turn out good? Show me."
(Show her the photo)

name: Nagisa
message: "...Wow, you weren't kidding. It really worked... And it looks totally normal, not like some creepy ghost pic."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Thank you for your cooperation."

name: Nagisa
message: "Hold up a sec."

name: Nagisa
message: "Ugh, I look awful... My hair's a mess too... This pic sucks..."

name: Shiori
message: "I totally get wanting to take another photo until you're satisfied with it."

name: Nagisa
message: "Can I fix my bangs first? It's what's bothering me the most."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Go ahead."

name: Nagisa
message: "You got a mirror?"

name: Shiori
message: "I don't, but maybe..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Me neither."

name: Nagisa
message: "Just use your phone and switch it to selfie mode."
(Do as she says)

name: Nagisa
message: "Whoa, crazy. I'm showing up like normal... Aren't ghosts supposed to be like, invisible?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Perhaps they do show up on machines, but people who can't 'see' them simply can't perceive them."

name: Nagisa
message: "Huh... So maybe ghosts show up on security cameras too, and people just can't 'see' them..."

name: Nagisa
message: "...Hmm. Still not perfect, but whatever. Thanks."

name: Nagisa
message: "You can take it now."
(Take a photo)

name: Nagisa
message: "...Done? Show me."
(Show her the photo)

name: Nagisa
message: "Still not satisfied, but it's better than before, I guess..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Is everything alright now?"

name: Nagisa
message: "Not really, but it's fine."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Then thank you for your cooperation. We'll be going now."

name: Nagisa
message: "Hey."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yes?"

name: Nagisa
message: "Don't forget... about her."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Phew... good work, both of you."

name: Shiori
message: "Next, we should show this photo to different people, right?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yes. Someone unexpected might recognize her."

name: Shiori
message: "Should we ask Gyaruko-san to let us take her photo too?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...This is only a hypothesis, but if she were lying with something malicious in mind..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Then acting carelessly could put her on alert, and if that happens, the truth may slip even further away."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "More importantly, if my suspicions are unfounded... we could risk damaging Gyaruko-san's trust. I'd rather avoid that."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "We should first confirm Kirishiki-san's identity. We can deal with Gyaruko-san after that."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes... you're right. I want to believe Gyaruko-san. But for now, I think that's the best approach too."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Well then, shall we continue our investigation?"
